scope: stage-2 five-level heads only; stage-1, event-time heads and the separate stage-3 64-job envelope remain independent
objective: mean negative log of the whole-mixture reported target probability plus lambda*sum(nonconstant_beta^2)/2; every judged response remains in the denominator including all-unknown backoff
target_weight: one per individual usable five-level response; conflicting annotator responses retained separately
prior: empirical training-response counts plus 0.5 in each category, normalized once per training partition; never estimated from validation or calibration responses

aggregation.path_group_order: fixed stage-1 OOF path/group/context factors multiply supported local category probabilities; unrepresented weight stays unknown
aggregation.r: observed physical coverage * supported head mass
aggregation.stage4: separate positive T; transform only supported already-marginalized probabilities, then add unchanged prior; not yet fitted

solver.name: L-BFGS-B
solver.gradient: analytic mixture responsibility gradient; finite differences only in independent verification
solver.initial_cutpoints: logit of cumulative half-count training marginal
solver.guard_policy: hitting a delta guard is incomplete, not an adopted bounded model
solver.constant_coefficients: intercept slot fixed zero; any additional documented constant columns fixed zero; no data-driven feature selection
solver.restart_policy: none; failures retained, any extra start requires a new predeclared job
solver.completion: solver success, finite fully evaluated terminal vector, maximum absolute analytic gradient <=10*gtol and no delta guard contact within1e-8; fit_complete does not establish calibration or model acceptance
solver.elapsed_guard: check before and after each complete objective; one evaluation can overrun300s, which is recorded as incomplete; no partial objective is reported as complete
solver.floating_mass_correction: only roundoff sums in(1,1+1e-12] are scaled to1; genuine missing support is never normalized onto survivors

development_splits.source_family: all transformations and linked performer/source records belong to one frozen source-family partition
development_splits.heldout: intersection of one source-family fold and one participant fold
development_splits.training: exclude the union of their source families and participants
development_splits.coverage: 25 intersections cover each eligible development response exactly once; cross cells are never silently discarded
development_splits.hyperparameter_selection: mean held-out NLL over the same eligible targets across all25 cells; failed/incomplete candidate is not selectable; exact loss ties prefer larger lambda
development_splits.scales_and_earlier_stages: OOF feature/scaling provenance must exclude the same held-out families and participants; downstream fold labels alone do not establish leakage isolation
development_splits.calibration: separate development split; never used for lambda selection

job_accounting.status: template_only; dataset rows, all heads/variants, fold assignments, wall/core costs and full job IDs must be frozen before real fits; no stage2 feasibility pass
job_accounting.budget_scope: Nominal sum of solver timeouts, not measured end-to-end upper cost; include preprocessing, serialization, failed-call overruns and all job variants in the required compute preflight.

on_failure: retain best fully evaluated objective/vector as diagnostic only with failed/incomplete status; do not adopt coefficients, omit failed folds, extend bounds or add hidden restarts
